svg.title: Animated three-dimensional Euler phase helix
svg.desc: A rotating unit phasor automatically rises along a time axis to trace a three-dimensional helix. Its shadow on the complex plane shows the Euler phase and the residual one minus exp i theta.
svg.text: Complex rotation becomes a helix in time
The circle is the shadow. Lift phase along time and the same motion traces a three-dimensional screw.

g.text: (cos θ, sin θ, θ / 2π) — a 3D lift of — eiθ
eiθ = cos θ + i sin θ
At each full turn, the residual
closes while the helix keeps rising.

svg.text: Projection is orthographic and oblique for legibility. The time coordinate is a visual lift, not an extra component of the complex number.
